catalog.name: BUDDY
catalog.effect: Normal form: cards played in BUDDY's district cost 1 less Motion (minimum 0). After two rounds, BUDDY gains +3 Hands and planted Buddy Buds sprout. On reveal, plant Buds in two or three randomly chosen eligible districts; when each Bud sprouts, it gives +3 Hands to the last eligible friendly character already in its district. Full districts are skipped; Buds that sprout with no eligible friendly recipient remain harmless and give no Hands. Buds planted too late to sprout before match end are not placed.

catalog.name: FOLKS
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply 3 Burn to every enemy on the board. Give every other friendly Fire character +1 Hand. Burn deals its stacked Hands loss once at round end; Fire deals +1 Burn against Plant.

catalog.name: Dr. Fade
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give the strongest enemy here -2 Hands. Give your weakest ally in another district +2 Hands.

catalog.name: GUAP
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hands for each other friendly character across the board, up to +5. Give every enemy across the board -1 Hands. Once per round. Ongoing: While GUAP is in your hand, your other Fire characters gain +1 Hands at round end.

catalog.name: Boss Bae
catalog.effect: The first 2 times you play a card in another district, gain +1 Hands. After the second, your next card costing 4 or more costs 1 less Motion.

catalog.name: Scammer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Copy the base Hands (up to 7) and printed ability of the strongest active Ongoing enemy here. If none exists, copy only the strongest enemy's base Hands (up to 7) and gain +1 Hand. Copied entrances never trigger.

catalog.name: Rastamon
catalog.effect: Cleanse a frozen or silenced ally here and give it +2 Hands. If none needs cleansing, give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand.

catalog.name: All Jokes Roaster
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply 1 Burn to the highest-Hands enemy here and deal 1 immediate damage, or 2 if it was played this round.

catalog.name: Closet Nerd
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Silence the highest-Hands active Ongoing enemy here, otherwise the strongest enemy, bypassing Wifey's Side Eye. Protection still blocks this. Newly interrupting an active Ongoing ability grants +1 Hand and reveals one enemy hand card.

catalog.name: Cornball
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply 1 Burn to every enemy here.

catalog.name: Plug
catalog.effect: Your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion.

catalog.name: Live Streamer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Reset your cheap-play trigger counter. The next 2 cards you play this turn with cost 2 or less gain +1 Hand each.

catalog.name: Gamer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands ally in each other district +2 Hands. Ongoing: While on board, the first time each round you newly Silence or Weaken an enemy, your lowest-Hands Dark ally gains +2 Hands. Ongoing: While Gamer is in your hand, your other Dark characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

catalog.name: Techbro Rich
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Borrow up to 1 Motion, up to the cap. At round end repay unspent borrowed Motion; any remainder reduces your next round starting Motion. Once per match.

catalog.name: Bikelife YN
catalog.effect: After reveal, ride to your weakest other district and gain +1 Hands.

catalog.name: Cool Vibe YN
catalog.effect: Pull your lowest ally from another district here. Both gain +1 Hands.

catalog.name: Hooper
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Challenge the strongest enemy here through next round. If it leaves this district, gain +3 Hands. Otherwise, at the end of next round, hit it for 3 and gain +1 Hand. One challenge per Hooper.

catalog.name: Baby Momma
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Name your weakest other ally here as family. Once, follow its successful move if there is room. Once per match when an enemy damages it, hit the attacker for 2; if family was destroyed, also gain +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Officer Oink
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply Weaken to every enemy card here. Gain +1 Hands for each enemy Weakened.

catalog.name: Snow Bunny
catalog.effect: Freeze the highest enemy card here. Frozen cards add 0 Hands until cleansed.

catalog.name: Wifey
catalog.effect: Block the first targeted enemy effect here each round.

catalog.name: Barber Bro
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 2 bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus Hands. Give the amount actually trimmed to your weakest other ally here. If no enemy has bonus Hands, give that ally +1 Hand. Ongoing: While Barber Bro is in your hand, your other Normal characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

catalog.name: Bottle Girl
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If played on Round 4 or later, gain +2 Hands. Your next Poison character costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1, through the next round.

catalog.name: Sneaker Reseller
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Gain +X Hands where X is the printed Power of the highest-Hands enemy on the board, up to +3. Apply Weaken to that enemy.

catalog.name: Church Auntie
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other ally here +3 Hands if Light, or +2 otherwise, and Protect. Ongoing: While on board, the first time each round protection blocks a hostile effect on one of your Light characters, it gains +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Landlord
catalog.effect: Ongoing: The first enemy card played at this district each round costs 1 additional Motion. When that tax is actually paid, Landlord gains +1 Hands once per round.

catalog.name: Car Meet Kid
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move Car Meet Kid to your weakest other district. Then give its lowest-Hands other friendly card +1 Hands.

catalog.name: Promoter
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Reveal one enemy hand card. If it costs 4+, your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion. Ongoing: While on board, the first Air ally, Bottle Girl, Pirate Radio DJ, or Dance Captain to move each round gains +2 Hands (one shared trigger).

catalog.name: Nail Tech
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give another friendly card here +2 Hands. The next time that card is hit by an enemy Hands reduction, reduce that loss by 1. Ongoing: While Nail Tech is in your hand, your other Poison characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

catalog.name: OG Uncle
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If your opponent has more total cards on the board than you, gain +3 Hands. If they have at least 3 more, also give their lowest-Hands card here -1 Hands.

catalog.name: Delivery Demon
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move the lowest-Hands other friendly 1- or 2-Cost card here to your weakest other district.

catalog.name: Young Bull
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand. If an enemy is here, also apply 1 Burn to the highest-Hands enemy here.

catalog.name: Racially Ambiguous Transplant
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If you have no other cards here, gain +1 Hands.

catalog.name: Bad Lil Cousin Tayaty
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand, then repeat the last resolved On Reveal if it is repeatable, using Tayaty as its source. If it cannot be repeated, gain Protection instead. Persistent creative contracts cannot be re-armed.

catalog.name: Edgar
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly character here costs 2 or less, gain +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Nguyen
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If you have a friendly card in another district, gain +1 Hands.

catalog.name: Man-Man
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If you have at least 2 other friendly characters here, gain +3 Hands.

catalog.name: Pinay Nurse
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other ally here +3 Hands and cleanse its freeze and silence.

catalog.name: Honest Thot
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Name your weakest other district. Through next round, your next Air character entering there gains +2 Hands. One welcome per side.

catalog.name: Earthy Sugar Foot
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other card here +1 Hands.

catalog.name: Abuela
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest injured ally anywhere +1 Hand, restore up to 3 Hands actually lost to damage, and Protect it. If nobody is injured, give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand, Protect it, and pack one lunch: heal up to 2 Hands of its first later enemy damage if it survives. Ongoing: While Abuela is in your hand, your other Light characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

catalog.name: Ice Cream Truck
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Serve a +2-Hand Treat to your weakest other ally here, or leave it for the next friendly character arriving here. Ongoing: At round start, move to your weakest legal unvisited district and serve its weakest other ally, or leave a Treat if alone. Any successful first visit serves that district. One pending Treat per district per side; each district once per truck. Movement locks apply.

catalog.name: Shiesty YN
catalog.effect: On Reveal: 50% chance to summon another Shiesty YN here. Each summoned copy repeats this effect, up to 8 extra.

catalog.name: Torta
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Pair yourself with your weakest other Earth ally here and Protect that partner. At next round end (or final round end), if both remain here and you are not losing this district, each gains +3 Hands. One pair per side. Ongoing: While Torta is in your hand, your other Earth characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

catalog.name: Water Boy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly card is here, gain +1 Motion.

catalog.name: Bus Pass
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Issue a Transfer Ticket. Your next character costs 1 less Motion and arrives with +2 Hands. Supports cannot spend the ticket.

catalog.name: Cognac Bottle
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest friendly character here +3 Hands, or +4 if it is Fire.

catalog.name: Bust-Down Watch
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest friendly character here +1 Hand and Protection. If this ward blocks a hostile ability, its wearer gains +2 Hands once. Other shields do not cash this watch.

catalog.name: Soul Food
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest afflicted friendly character here, or your weakest if nobody is afflicted, and give it +3 Hands.

catalog.name: Balikbayan Box Bot
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Leave a care package in each other district through next round. The next ally played or moved there gains +1 Hand (+2 if Earth) and is cleansed. One package per district per side.

catalog.name: Bodega Cat
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If you have no other friendly cards here, gain +1 Hands.

catalog.name: Crossing Guard
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Protect your weakest unprotected other ally here. Give it one Safe Crossing: its next successful move ignores movement Lock. Capacity and district restrictions still apply.

catalog.name: Laundromat Regular
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it +1 Hand. Its next successful move cleanses it again and gives it +1 Hand, once.

catalog.name: Corner Busker
catalog.effect: Ongoing: The first distinct other ally moving here gives your weakest other local ally +1 Hand; the second gives +2. At most one two-visitor payout per round. A visitor cannot tip twice toward a payout.

catalog.name: Corner Coach
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Coach your weakest eligible ally here through next round. Later friendly placements retry its failed entrance until one succeeds. Coachable: Edgar, Nguyen, Man-Man, Transplant, Bodega Cat, Dog Walker, Sports Prodigy, Homeless YN, Dragonfly Jones, OG Uncle, Barber Bro, Night Shift Medic, Squabble House Worker — Female, The Feds. If nobody qualifies, give your weakest other ally here +3 Hands instead.

catalog.name: Night Cashier
catalog.effect: On Reveal: On round 4 or later, issue a Receipt here through next round. Your next other character costing 2 or less played here earns an immediate one-use local 1-Motion character discount, minimum 1. In the final round, that customer gains +2 Hands instead.

catalog.name: Dog Walker
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If at least 2 other friendly characters are here, gain +3 Hands.

catalog.name: Mural Apprentice
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Paint this district with your element through next round. The next other friendly character of a different element entering here gains +2 Hands. One paint per district per side.

catalog.name: Chess Regular
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy in up to two different districts through next round. With one mark, wait for an enemy placement in another district to complete the Fork. The next enemy placement after completion saves that district; other marked enemies lose 2 Hands. If a marked enemy loses Hands, Chess Regular gains +1 Hand. One Fork per side.

catalog.name: Rooftop Gardener
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Plant a Seed here. At the end of this round, your weakest Plant ally here gains +4 Hands. One plot per district per side. Ongoing: While Rooftop Gardener is in your hand, your other Plant characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

catalog.name: Pirate Radio DJ
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands ally in each other district +1 Hand. Ongoing: In hand, your other Electric characters gain +1 Hand at round end. On board, your second Electric character played each round gains +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Dance Circle Captain
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, the first friendly character move sets a destination. The next different friendly character moving there gains +2 Hands and Protection.

catalog.name: Night Shift Medic
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse Freeze, Silence, Burn, Weaken, and Lock from every other ally here. Give your weakest other Light character here +1 Hand, even if healthy. Ongoing: While on board, the first Light character you cleanse each round gains +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Subway Magician
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply Weaken to the highest-Hands enemy here, then move to your weakest other district.

catalog.name: OG Dominican
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other district. If moved, gain +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Last Train Conductor
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move your lowest-Hands other ally here to your weakest other district. If moved, Cleanse it and give it +2 Hands, or +3 if it is Water.

catalog.name: Midnight Mayor
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Nominate your weakest other district through next round. The next friendly move there grants that mover Protection and opens one local 1-Motion character discount, minimum 1. One nomination per side.

catalog.name: Big Zoey
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other ally here +2 Hands and the lowest-Hands enemy here -2 Hands.

catalog.name: Leroy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 4 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus, then hit that enemy for 2; with no bonus target, hit the strongest enemy here for 2. If your board has at least three friendly elements, gain +3 Hands and Protection. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity block the hostile package.

catalog.name: Block Party Titan
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Bring the weakest movable ally from each other district here, if there is space. Gain +1 Hand for each ally that arrives, up to +2.

catalog.name: Energy Drink
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Restore 3 Motion, up to the 9-Motion cap.

catalog.name: Phone Charger
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Restore 1 Motion per friendly character here, up to 3. With at least 3 characters here, also Protect your weakest local Electric character.

catalog.name: First Aid Kit
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest afflicted character here, or your weakest character if none is afflicted. Store one emergency kit: prevent up to 2 Hands of its next enemy damage before lethal resolution. One kit per target.

catalog.name: Boombox
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give every friendly character here +1 Hand. Leave one Encore through next round: the next friendly movement arrival here gains +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Subway Map
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move your lowest-Hands friendly character here to your weakest other district. If moved, give it +1 Hands.

catalog.name: Buttahs
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands friendly character here +2 Hands and protect it from one targeted hostile ability.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse A Side of Hands
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest friendly character here +2 Hands and your strongest enemy character here -2 Hands. Protection and immunity can block only the hostile effect.

catalog.name: Homeless YN
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If enemies outnumber your other friendly cards here, gain +3 Hands.

catalog.name: Sports Prodigy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If losing this district, gain +2 Hands and give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hand. Otherwise, arm one comeback through next round (once per match): when an enemy arrival turns this district from tied or winning to losing, gain +2 Hands and give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hand.

catalog.name: Fein
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If an enemy is here, gain +1 Hand. If 2 or more enemies are here, also apply 1 Burn to the highest-Hands enemy.

catalog.name: Alchy
catalog.effect: Ongoing: On round 4 or later, gain +1 Hands at round end. Gain an extra +1 if you are losing this district.

catalog.name: STUD
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand and bond to it. Once while together, intercept its next targeted hostile ability, then try to move the surviving pair to your weakest other district with two spaces. Protect the surviving partner whether the escape succeeds or is blocked.

catalog.name: Goth Kid
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to the first completely empty district. The first enemy played or moved there while you remain active is Silenced before its ability. If no empty district is available, Silence the lowest-Hands enemy here with a printed cost of 3 or less.

catalog.name: Stoner Jr.
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your lowest-Hands frozen or silenced friendly character here. If cleansed, give it +1 Hands.

catalog.name: Stoner Sr.
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest afflicted ally here and leave a token through next round. Your next other character arriving here gains +4 Hands. If you cleansed an ally, pass a smaller +1 token once to a different arrival.

catalog.name: Divorced Dad
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Bring your weakest movable ally costing 2 or less from another district here if there is room; Protect it. Through next round, its first successful move back to its original district gains +1 Hand. It never returns automatically. One visit per side.

catalog.name: BBL Nice
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Pair your two weakest other allies anywhere through next round. Once per round, the first positive Hands gain on one shares up to 2 Hands with the other. Shared gains cannot repeat.

catalog.name: BBL Demon
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy district with Drama until the next enemy character placement or match end. Played there: that character gets -2 Hands. Played elsewhere: BBL Demon gains +2 Hands. One Drama per side.

catalog.name: Break
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other ally here to your weakest other open district. If it moves, leave a floor mark here through next round: Weaken the next enemy character entering. One mark per district per side.

catalog.name: Krump
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If an enemy is here, gain +2 Hands and give the highest-Hands enemy here -2 Hands.

catalog.name: Bboy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move through your weakest other occupied friendly district, then to the remaining district if open. Gain +1 Hand per successful move, up to +2.

catalog.name: Yung Hustle
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If a friendly character is in another district, restore 1 Motion, up to 9.

catalog.name: Failed Rapper
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Leave a Verse here through next round. The next different friendly character entering by play or movement gains +2 Hands. Played characters collect after their entrance. One Verse per district per side.

catalog.name: Failed Athlete
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Once per match, gain +4 Hands and Protection when this district changes from tied or winning to losing. If deployed while losing, a later enemy arrival here while still losing can also trigger the comeback.

catalog.name: Incel
catalog.effect: Ongoing: At round end, if you are the only friendly character here, gain +2 Hands, at most twice per match.

catalog.name: Red Pill
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply Weaken to the highest-Hands enemy here. If already Weakened, Silence them and gain +2 Hands instead.

catalog.name: Simmy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give the highest-Hands enemy here -3 Hands and your lowest-Hands other friendly character here +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Foodz
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse every other friendly character on your board. Give your weakest other character in each district +2 Hands. Give an extra +2 to the weakest Light ally actually cleansed. Community Serving: once per side per match, also give your weakest Homeless ally in each district +2 Hands and Protection, including Cracked Head. The serving is spent only when a Homeless ally is present; copies and repeated reveals share it.

catalog.name: Dragonfly Jones
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Target the enemy here with the most removable bonus Hands, otherwise the highest-cost enemy costing 4 or more, otherwise the strongest enemy. Hit it for 4 if it has bonus Hands or costs 4 or more; otherwise hit it for 2. Gain +1 Hand only if damage lands.

catalog.name: Sho'Nuff
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 5 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus Hands and gain the amount actually taken. If no enemy has bonus Hands, hit the strongest enemy here for 3. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity apply.

catalog.name: Yasuke
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest unprotected other ally here +2 Hands and Protection, then hit the strongest enemy here for 2. Protection and immunity apply to the hit.

catalog.name: Mansa Musa
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other friendly character in each district +1 Hand, or +2 if that ally is Earth. Your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion.

catalog.name: TRON
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give up to three lowest-Hands other friendly characters here +1 Hands each. If all three gained Hands, restore 1 Motion.

catalog.name: John Henry
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand for each other friendly Earth character across the board, up to +4. If at least two are here, give the strongest enemy here -2 Hands.

catalog.name: Ashlee
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Drop Guyana the gorilla (+4, uncounterable) into your weakest friendly district. Give every other friendly character in Ashlee's district +1 Hand. Give the highest-Hands enemy on the board -1 Hand. If Plant allies occupy at least two districts, give your lowest-Hands Plant ally in each occupied district +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Captain Jigga
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Send two 2-Hand Stewards here. Each targets a different highest-Hands enemy for -2 Hands and gives your lowest-Hands other Air character here +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Shotta
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 2. Ongoing: After you play another character in a different district, fire 1 at its strongest enemy. Two encores per match, at most one per round.

catalog.name: Homeless Guy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Choose 0–4 extra Motion; gain that many Hands, plus 1 if you invested any Motion. If the deployment cost alone spent your last Motion, instead steal up to 2 Hands from the strongest enemy here.

catalog.name: Fangirl
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Your strongest other ally here becomes your idol. Ongoing: The first time your idol gains Hands each round, gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Grown-Man Fanboy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Your strongest other ally becomes your idol. Ongoing: Intercept the first hostile ability targeting your idol each round. If Fangirl is here when you take the hit, gain +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Lawless YN
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move the weakest enemy here to their strongest other open district. If it moves, Lawless YN gains +1 Hand. Protection, immunity and movement locks can stop this.

catalog.name: The Street Apostle
catalog.effect: Ongoing: The first time another Plant ally gains Hands each round, repeat up to 2 of that gain onto your weakest Plant ally in each other district. Copied gains cannot trigger this again.

catalog.name: The Asphalt Apostle
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Protect your weakest other Earth ally anywhere and give it +1 Hand. Ongoing: Once per round, block the first hostile forced move against an Earth ally; give that ally +2 Hands instead.

catalog.name: Cologne Criminal
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Leave Lingering Scent here through the end of next round. The first enemy entering this district each round gets 2 Burn, even if moved here. Scent stays after you leave.

catalog.name: Passport Bro
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest movable other ally here to your weakest other legal open district. If it moves, cleanse it and give it +2 Hands. Ongoing: Once per round, when another Water ally leaves a district you are losing, cleanse it and give it +3 Hands. The reveal and passive can both reward a qualifying move.

catalog.name: Seafood Assassin
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply 2 Burn to every enemy here, then immediately detonate all their Burn as Hands damage and consume it. Protection blocks the whole hit.

catalog.name: Homeless Legend
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Survive your first lethal Hands reduction at 1 Hand. At round end, recover up to 2 Hands lost to damage.

catalog.name: God of Hookah
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply 1 Burn to the weakest unburned enemy character in another district. Ongoing: At round end, the first enemy damaged by Burn in each district passes 1 Burn to the weakest unburned enemy in the next district. New Burn waits until next round. If that district has enemies but all were already burning, gain +1 Hand, at most once per round.

catalog.name: The Mailman
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Your second Electric character played each round sends a Package to your weakest other open district. The next Electric character played there costs 1 less Motion and gains +2 Hands. Only one Package can be pending.

catalog.name: Lola
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Invite your weakest movable ally from each other district here. Cleanse each arrival and give it +1 Hand. At round end, send guests home with another +1 if they return. Needs space.

catalog.name: Repo Man
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Tow the enemy with the most bonus Hands from another district here. If it arrives, give up to 3 of its bonus Hands to your weakest ally here. Protection, immunity and movement rules apply.

catalog.name: Mad Hatter
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other ally here to hand with +1 Hand and −1 Motion on its next play (minimum 1). If there is room, pull your strongest movable ally from another district here. The cheaper guest also gains +3 Hands; the other gains Protection if still on the board. Equal costs: +1 Hand each. If alone here, gain +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Track Suit Auntie
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest legal other district.

catalog.name: Gym Bag YN
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other local Fitness ally to your weakest legal other district. One successful Bag Check per side per round.

catalog.name: Stairwell Sprinter
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to an unvisited legal district. Gain +1 Hand after arrival once per instance per match.

catalog.name: Last Set OG
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If a friendly Fitness character has visited all three districts, give your weakest Fitness ally in each occupied district +2 Hands. Otherwise Protect your weakest other local Fitness ally. One circuit finish per side per match.

catalog.name: Tour Van Driver
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Bring your weakest movable Music ally from another district here. Both gain +2 Hands after arrival. Once per side per round.

catalog.name: Mixtape Cousin
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other local Music ally to your weakest legal other district; it gains +2 Hands and this gains +1 Hand only after arrival. Once per side per round.

catalog.name: Merch Table Hustler
catalog.effect: Ongoing: The first different Music character successfully resolving an entrance here each round earns one local Music discount of 1 Motion through the following round, minimum 1. Two discounts per side per match. Echoes do not count.

catalog.name: The Favorite Grandchild
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest legal other district.

catalog.name: Cousin Back From College
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other local Fire or Family ally to your weakest legal other district. Only after arrival, give it +2 Hands once per side per round.

catalog.name: Plate Auntie
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Recover up to 3 lost Hands and remove Burn from your weakest injured other local Fire or Family ally; Protect it if healing or Burn removal succeeds. If nobody is injured, remove one eligible ally’s Burn; if nobody needs either, give your weakest eligible ally +3 Hands instead. With no eligible ally, save +3 Hands for the next other Fire or Family ally arriving here through next round while Auntie is here and active; once, no echoes.

catalog.name: Church Auntie’s Rival
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local Fire or Family ally +1 Hand and Protection.

catalog.name: Big Sister
catalog.effect: Ongoing: The first different Fire or Family ally moving here each round gains +3 Hands. Three payouts per side per match.

catalog.name: Second Plate Cousin
catalog.effect: Ongoing: When another local Fire or Family ally genuinely gains Hands, gain +3 Hands. Once per round, two payouts per side per match. Copied gains cannot trigger sharing.

catalog.name: Grill Uncle
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply 2 Burn to the strongest enemy here. Ongoing: Actual enemy Burn damage here grants +2 Hands once per round, twice per side per match. The first different Fire or Family ally successfully resolving an entrance here each round applies 1 Burn to the strongest enemy here, twice per side per match. Echoes do not count.

catalog.name: Grandma Said Sit Down
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 2 Hands, or 4 if two distinct friendly characters moved this round. One successful entrance per instance per match.

catalog.name: Gym Spotter YN
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local Fitness ally +1 Hand and Protection. Its next successful move through next round grants +1 Hand once.

catalog.name: Calisthenics YN
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Your first successful move each round gains +2 Hands. Two payouts per instance per match.

catalog.name: OG Calisthenics
catalog.effect: In Hand: Your first successful Fitness move each round grants that athlete +1 Hand, twice per side per match. On Reveal: If Fitness allies occupy all three districts, give your weakest Fitness ally in each district +3 Hands. Otherwise give your weakest other local Fitness ally +3 Hands and Protection. Once per side per match.

catalog.name: Night Bus Driver
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Bring your weakest movable ally from another district here if there is space. The first successful pickup by this driver gives the passenger +2 Hands per match; returns do not reset it.

catalog.name: Community Cook
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Recover up to 4 lost Hands on your weakest injured other ally here; otherwise give your weakest other ally here +3 Hands. A Homeless recipient is also cleansed, gains +2 Hands and Protection. Cracked Head counts as Homeless. One meal per recipient per side per match; copies and returns cannot refeed the same recipient.

catalog.name: Jump Rope Menace
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Your first distinct Fitness mover each round grants +2 Hands; the second grants +1 Hand. Each leg pays at most twice per side per match.

catalog.name: Delivery App Cyclist
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest legal other district. Give your weakest other ally there +1 Hand after arrival, once per instance per match.

catalog.name: Studio Couch YN
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local Music ally +3 Hands.

catalog.name: Barbershop Heckler
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 2 bonus Hands from the strongest enemy with bonus Hands here. If any bonus was removed, your weakest other ally here gains +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Group Chat Instigator
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 1 Hand. If damage lands and two different friendly characters moved this round, hit the strongest enemy in another district for 1.

catalog.name: Bluetooth Unc
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Remove Silence from your weakest silenced other ally here. If none is silenced, Protect your weakest other ally here instead.

catalog.name: One-Man Band
catalog.effect: In Hand: Your first successful different Music entrance each round grants that artist +2 Hands, twice per side per match. Echoes do not count. On Reveal: If Music allies occupy all three districts, give your weakest Music ally in each district +3 Hands; otherwise give your weakest other local Music ally +4 Hands. Once per side per match.

catalog.name: Booster
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 1 bonus Hand from the strongest enemy with bonus Hands here and gain that amount. One successful steal per instance per match.

catalog.name: Indian Scammer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 2 bonus Hands from the strongest enemy with bonus Hands here. If bonus Hands were removed, give your weakest other local ally +1 Hand and Protection. Once per instance per match.

catalog.name: Naija Scammer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Summon a 0-Motion / 1-Hand Fake Marriage token here if there is space, then Protect your weakest other character here. One summon per side per match. The token earns +1 Hand when a different ally moves here, once per round, twice per match.

catalog.name: Black Air Fade 1’s
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other character here +1 Hand and Protection. Its next successful move this round grants +1 Hand once. One fitting per target per match.

catalog.name: Hair Stylist
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it +1 Hand. If cleansed, its next successful move grants another +1 Hand, once.

catalog.name: Stylist
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand and Protection. Its next successful move refreshes its Protection once. One fitting per target.

catalog.name: Demario
catalog.effect: While in hand: At the start of each round, summon one 2-Hand Mushroom in a random open district. On Reveal: Summon one more Mushroom in a random open district. Full districts are skipped. The next friendly character played in a Mushroom’s district consumes one for +2 Hands; normal or Powered Luigion gets +2 on reveal. Echoes never consume Mushrooms.

catalog.name: Luigion
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand, then give your weakest other friendly character here +1 Hand; if none, gain a second +1. Consume at most one local friendly Mushroom for +2 Hands per deployment, never on echoes. Squabble transforms into Powered Luigion: the Mushroom replaces the solo +1, then jump to your weakest other open district for +1 Hand if the move succeeds.

catalog.name: Black Cowboy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Lasso the weakest enemy from another district here if there is room. If it arrives, mark it Wanted through next round. If your side destroys it, gain +3 Hands.

catalog.name: Inmate Crafty
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly inmate or a friendly support card is here, gain +3 Hands.

catalog.name: Inmate Boyfriend
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +3 Hands. Also give your weakest friendly Cellblock character in another district +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Inmate Informant
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give the strongest enemy here -3 Hands. Protection and immunity can block this.

catalog.name: Inmate Contraband
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly character is here, restore 1 Motion, up to the Motion cap.

catalog.name: Regular guy named LeBron James
catalog.effect: A fictional regular guy. On Reveal: Cleanse and Protect your weakest other ally here. Once per match, when that Protection blocks an enemy ability, hit its source for 3.

catalog.name: Dorothy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other friendly character in any district with a printed cost of 2 or less to your hand. Its next deployment costs 1 less Motion (minimum 1) and gains +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Scarecrow
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Swap districts with your weakest ally in another open district. If both can move, both gain +1 Hand. If there is no legal ally to swap with, move to the first completely empty legal district and gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Tin Man
catalog.effect: Ongoing: The first other ally entering your district each round gains +1 Hand. If it moved here or is another Oz traveler (Dorothy, Scarecrow, Tin Man, or Lion), it gains +2 Hands and Protection instead. Playing or moving an ally here qualifies.

catalog.name: Lion
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Gain Protection if you are alone here. Ongoing: Once per round, when another ally leaves your district, gain +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Oz
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Once per match, repeat the most recent eligible entrance by another friendly Oz traveler (Dorothy, Scarecrow, Tin Man, or Lion) still on the board, including earlier rounds. If none is eligible, repeat the most recent eligible entrance by another friendly character. That ally gains +3 Hands if it moved this round, otherwise +2 if it is an Oz traveler. Cannot repeat ability-copying effects or persistent creative contracts.

catalog.name: Alice
catalog.effect: Ongoing: At round end, return to your hand once per match, except during the final round. Your next deployment gains +3 Hands and costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1.

catalog.name: Cheshire
catalog.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand or on the board, the first ally returned to your hand each round leaves a 4-Hand Grin in its district. Maximum one friendly Grin per district.

catalog.name: Queen of Hearts
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Execute the weakest enemy here if it has 6 or fewer Hands. A successful execution summons a 2-Hand Card Guard. Protection can block execution.

catalog.name: Mr Rabbit
catalog.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand, other friendly characters returned to hand cost 1 less Motion on their next deployment (minimum 1). While on the board, gain +1 Hand each time another friendly character returns to hand.

catalog.name: Sherlock
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Watch both other unlocked districts through next round. Cancel the first enemy entrance ability in either, then close both stakeouts. If Sherlock is active when it cancels, he and your weakest other friendly character anywhere gain +2 Hands each.

catalog.name: Watson
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Restore up to 3 Hands actually lost to damage to your weakest injured ally here and Protect it; otherwise Protect your weakest other ally here. Also Protect a friendly Sherlock anywhere and give him +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Undercova Brotha
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, after an enemy deployed here resolves its entrance, steal 2 Hands plus up to 2 removable bonus Hands, gaining only the actual amount taken, up to 4. Escape to your weakest other open district only if Hands were taken. At most two payouts per side per match; copies share the limit.

catalog.name: The Feds
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 8 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus and Lock it. If no enemy has bonus Hands, Lock and Weaken the strongest enemy here instead. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity block the whole package.

catalog.name: DMV Worker
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Post one queue ticket here through next round and gain +1 Hand. The next enemy character entrance here waits until round end, then resolves if that character is still active. One ticket per district per side; no repeat delay.

catalog.name: P. Tang
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Deal 3 damage to the strongest enemy here, then knock the survivor into the next open district. If that damage lands and the target survives but cannot be moved, gain +2 Hands once for this deployment. Protection and immunity block the whole package.

catalog.name: Bonnet Girl
catalog.effect: Ongoing: The first time an enemy damages another ally here, gain +2 Hands. Once per match.

catalog.name: Corrupt Pastor
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Take 1 Hand from each other ally here, leaving each with at least 1. Gain 2 Hands per actual donation.

catalog.name: Powerhouse
catalog.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand, bank up to 3 Motion refunded by other cards. On Reveal: Deal that much damage to every enemy here.

catalog.name: Revolutionary Ronald
catalog.effect: Ongoing: The first time each round an enemy damages another ally here, Protect your weakest movable character in another district, then bring it here if there is room.

catalog.name: Trap Vamp
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, when your ability damages an enemy here, gain that much Hands, up to 2.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Cook
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, when an enemy ability damages another ally here, deal 2 damage back to its source.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Server
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse Burn and Freeze from your weakest affected ally here.

catalog.name: Sugarfoot
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. If it was already Weakened, gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: YN Gokarter
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Ongoing: After visiting all three districts, gain +3 Hands once per match.

catalog.name: YN ATV Lord
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move with your weakest other ally here to your weakest other district with two spaces. Both must be movable. Protect your passenger after arrival and give it +1 Hand.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Janitor
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Two charges/district/round separately reverse first enemy Hands loss/harmful status on any ally and first enemy-forced move/return/execution on staff; +2 Hands each. Duplicates share both; damage deaths use harm.

catalog.name: Homeless Wiseman
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Predict the enemy's weakest open district from the public board through next round. Their next character played there is Weakened; played elsewhere, your next character in the predicted district costs 2 less Motion (minimum 1) through next round. One prediction per side. Protection and immunity can block Weaken.

catalog.name: Juneteenth Chair Guy
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Once per match, after an enemy damages another ally here or its Protection blocks an enemy ability, hit the attacker for 3 and give your weakest surviving other ally here Protection.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Manager
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If an enemy is here, gain +1 Hand. Ongoing: Gain +1 Hand for each other friendly Squabblehouse staff member anywhere on the board; Manager does not count himself. The first enemy played or moved here each round loses 1 Hand. Protection, immunity, and movement locks can stop the hostile effect.

catalog.name: Gator Boy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hands. If its Hands fall, gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Hot Tub Hottie
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your lowest-Hands frozen or silenced ally here and give it +1 Hand. If cleansed, gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Gas Station Sushi Chef
catalog.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand, your weakest other Water character in each district gains +1 Hand at round end. On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here.

catalog.name: Energy Drink Freak
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Restore 2 Motion, up to 9, once per card per match. Echoes cannot refund. In Hand: From round 2, at round start gain 1 Motion, up to 9, and lose 1 base Hand, minimum 1. One successful hand payout per side per round, at most three per side per match; copies share both limits. Returning never resets its lost base Hands or entrance refund.

catalog.name: Game Developer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Repair your lowest-Hands ally in another district with a negative Hands modifier: give it +1 Hand and restore 1 Motion, up to 9.

catalog.name: Electrician Foreman
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Post two jobs through next round. Your next two different Electric allies played or moved each gain +1 Hand. When both take a job, restore 1 Motion once. One job pair per side.

catalog.name: E.V. Enthusiast
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion.

catalog.name: Dominican Phone Salesman
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other district. If you move, gain +1 Hand and your next card in a different district from your new location costs 1 less Motion. If the discounted card is a character, it gains +1 Hand when played.

catalog.name: OG Vegan
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other Plant ally here +2 Hands. If one is here, also gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Matcha Freak
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If you have at least 4 Motion left after playing this card, gain +2 Hands. Otherwise, cleanse your lowest-Hands frozen or silenced ally anywhere and give it +3 Hands. If nobody needs cleansing, give your weakest other Plant ally anywhere +3 Hands; if none exists, gain +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Performative Male
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand (+2 if Plant) and promise to help it. Through the next two rounds, if another card gives it Hands, cleanses it, or heals enemy damage, it gains +2 Hands (+3 if Plant) and you gain +1 Hand, once.

catalog.name: A Spare Gus
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give the strongest enemy in another district -2 Hands, then give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand and your weakest Plant ally in another district +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Big City Pigeon
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other district. If you move, give the weakest enemy there -1 Hand.

catalog.name: Baby Crying on an Airplane
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. Move your weakest other ally here to your weakest other district. If it moves, it gains +2 Hands.

catalog.name: The Flight Plug
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other Air ally here a Boarding Pass through next round. Its next successful move gives it +2 Hands and Protection, once. Ongoing: While The Flight Plug is in your hand, your other Air characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

catalog.name: Airheaded Model
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other district. If you move, gain +1 Hand and give your weakest ally left in the original district +2 Hands (+3 if Air) and Protection.

catalog.name: Bushedo Brown
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +2 Hands and Protection. Confiscate up to 4 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus; if no enemy has bonus, hit the strongest enemy here for 2. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity apply.

catalog.name: Franklin Duke
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If the strongest enemy here has more Hands than Franklin Duke or has removable bonus Hands, hit it for 4 and gain +3 Hands only if damage lands. Otherwise, give your weakest ally in another district +3 Hands and Protection.

catalog.name: Chonk Lee
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy in each district for 2. Gain +1 Hand for each enemy actually damaged, up to +3. Protection and immunity block both the hit and its reward.

catalog.name: Red Plaid Petey
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. If you move, gain +1 Hand. Your next Red Side card costs 1 less Motion.

catalog.name: OG Red Night
catalog.effect: On Reveal and at the start of the next two rounds: Steal 1 Hand from the strongest enemy here and gain it. If no enemy is here, take 1 Hand from your strongest other ally here with at least 2 Hands, if possible. One attempt per round, maximum three turns. Protection and immunity can block enemy steals.

catalog.name: Red Robber
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Deal 1 damage to the strongest enemy here. 50% chance to summon one Red Robber in a random other open district; it deals 1 damage there but cannot summon again.

catalog.name: Red Hexer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. Protection can block the status.

catalog.name: Ruby Shades
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other Red Set or Red Side character anywhere +3 Hands; otherwise give your weakest other character +2 Hands. With no other character ally, gain +1 Hand and Weaken the strongest enemy here.

catalog.name: OG Blue
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Deal 3 damage to the strongest enemy in another district. Gain +1 Hand for each friendly Blue Side card on the board, including this one, plus +1 for each other district containing a friendly Blue Set card (up to +2 extra). This card cannot lose Hands.

catalog.name: lil Blue
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand. The next ally you deploy gains Protection.

catalog.name: Blue Scarf crashout
catalog.effect: On Reveal and each new round: Move your weakest other ally in each district one district over. Each turn, a 50/50 roll either gives moved allies +1 Hand or steals 1 Hand from an enemy for each moved ally.

catalog.name: Blue loco
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse Freeze and Silence from your weakest affected ally here and give it +2 Hands. Otherwise, Protect your weakest unprotected ally here and gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Blue Big Trippin
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. If it lands, gain +1 Hand. When destroyed, your next deployed card gains +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Wicked Witch
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Deal 2 damage to each enemy with bonus Hands here; gain +1 Hand for each affected enemy. Summon one Flying Monkeys here if there is space.

catalog.name: Flying Monkeys
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move the weakest enemy here to their weakest other open district and give it 1 Burn. Protection, movement locks, and a full district can stop the move.

catalog.name: Ganger Blue
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest Blue Set ally in another district +4 Hands and Protection, and gain +1 Hand. If there is no remote Blue Set ally, give your weakest other remote ally +3 Hands and Protection. With no remote ally, gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Ganger Red
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Deal 2 damage to the strongest enemy here that can lose Hands. If damage lands, gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Snitch
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Silence the strongest enemy here. If it is already Silenced, Weaken it instead. Protection and immunity can block the effect.

catalog.name: Cracked Head
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Deal 1 damage to each enemy here, up to 3 enemies. Gain +1 Hand for each enemy damaged, up to +2.

catalog.name: CLUE COOKY
catalog.effect: Only playable in the left district, even when its location adds Motion or the lane is locked. On Reveal: If you are losing this district, collect up to +3 Hands in homage per reveal. Other friendly Blue Set characters each contribute +1 without losing Hands and count first; other friendly characters pay 1 Hand each toward the remaining total, keeping at least 1. Then send the weakest enemy here to your strongest district with -1 Hand. Give your weakest Blue Set ally in each other district +1 Hand and Protection. CLUE COOKY cannot lose Hands, and this ability cannot be Silenced.

catalog.name: RED PUNCH
catalog.effect: Only playable in the right district, even when its location adds Motion or the lane is locked. On Reveal: Give every other character here, allies included, -1 Hand. Up to three strongest enemies that can lose Hands instead take 2 damage. Gain the Hands actually lost, up to +6 per reveal. Anyone RED PUNCH cannot touch is moved to another district out of respect. This ability cannot be Silenced.

catalog.name: INITIATION
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Mark this district as your territory. The next character you play here is put on by the set you already have here: it takes their colors and gains +2 Hands. With no set of yours here, it still gains +2 Hands. The mark holds until it is used.

catalog.name: BLOCK SPINNER
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Put 1 Burn on one enemy here, and leave the block spinning: the next enemy played here takes 1 Burn too.

catalog.name: LOOK OUT
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Watch the block. The next district your opponent plays into is called out, and your next card there costs 1 less Motion. When you make the call, give your weakest other Blue Set ally +2 Hands. At round start, watch again if you have another Blue Set ally. Maximum one call per round and three calls per match.

catalog.name: Miami Surgeon
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it +2 Hands.

catalog.name: Roommate
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If another ally is here, gain +1 Hand.

catalog.name: Ahki
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Remember your weakest other ally here and give it +1 Hand. Its first departure from this district grants +1 Hand; its first later return grants another +1 Hand and Protection. Each reward once.

catalog.name: Mr. Trick
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Open a Tab through next round. The next other friendly character played here becomes your guest. Its first successful enemy hit or new harmful status earns a Tip; cash it at round end for +2 Hands to the guest. One Tab per side.

catalog.name: Dr. Umah
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Start a Group Project through next round. Your next two different-element allies to resolve successful entrances gain +1 Hand each. When both contribute, each gains another +2 Hands and Dr. Umah gains +1 Hand if still active. One project per side.

catalog.name: ATL Scammer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: File a claim through next round. Divert up to 1 Motion from the next enemy refund. If unused, at expiry open a one-use local 1-Motion character discount here through next round, minimum 1. Theft or fallback, never both.

catalog.name: Hater
catalog.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, after an enemy here gains bonus Hands, remove up to 1 of that new bonus and gain +1 Hand if any was removed. Cannot remove base Hands.

catalog.name: Teacher Who Never Believed in Rappers
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Silence the highest-Hands enemy here with an active Ongoing ability. If none exists, Silence the strongest enemy here. Protection and district guards apply.

catalog.name: Tattoo Artist
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Tattoo your weakest uninked other ally here and give it +1 Hand. Its next successful move grants Protection and +1 Hand. Each character can receive this tattoo only once per match.

catalog.name: OG Skater
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Leave a route at your origin through next round. The next friendly character played there follows you to the destination if movable and there is room. One route per origin per side.

catalog.name: Inmate Kingpin
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give Contraband and +1 Hand to your weakest other Inmate anywhere; if none, Kingpin holds it for the next Inmate. Later Inmate deployments or moves pass it on; each of the first three distinct carriers gains +1 Hand. After three carriers, each survivor gains another +1. Once per Kingpin per match.

catalog.name: Live Streamer — Male
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand for each other friendly character here costing 2 or less, up to +2.

catalog.name: Redneck
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here.

catalog.name: Redneck Evil
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Apply 2 Burn to the strongest enemy here and prime it through next round. Its next Burn damage, or its earlier defeat by your side, splashes 2 damage to the weakest other enemy in its district. One primer per target; splash cannot repeat.

catalog.name: Lawyer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it an Appeal through next round. Its next harmful status waits until round end; moving or cleansing the client dismisses it and earns one local 1-Motion character discount at the client, minimum 1.

catalog.name: Nigerian Father
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Tutor your weakest untutored other ally here for +1 Hand. If it gains another net +2 Hands by the end of next round, it gains Protection and +2 Hands. One goal per side; each character can be tutored once per match.

catalog.name: Bouncer
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move the strongest active Ongoing enemy here to another open enemy district. If none exists, move the strongest enemy here. Protection, capacity and movement restrictions apply.

catalog.name: Rent-a-Cop
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Post a warning here through next round. The next enemy character played here or moving into or out of this district takes 1 damage. If the warning deals damage, Rent-a-Cop gains +1 Hand if still active. One warning per district per side.

catalog.name: The Shootout
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Hit every enemy here for 3 Hands; your strongest character here takes 1 damage.

catalog.name: The Block Spin
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Repeat every Hands reduction already dealt here this round three more times on surviving characters still here. Repeated damage cannot repeat itself.

catalog.name: The Sideshow
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move all characters from both sides out of this district into other legal districts. Each friendly character successfully moved gains +2 Hands. Locked cards stay.

catalog.name: The Concert
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Choose: give allies here +3 Hands and enemies +1; or hit enemies here for 3 and allies for 1.

catalog.name: The Setup
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Sacrifice your weakest character here. Give your strongest other character here its current Hands plus 4 and Protection. Requires two allies.

catalog.name: The Dice Game
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Wager 1–3 Motion (both sides must afford it). Each side rolls three D6; add the highest two. Winner takes the pot, up to 9 Motion, and gives their weakest local character +3 Hands. Ties refund both wagers.

catalog.name: The After Party
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Extend this fight to 7 rounds and give every friendly character +2 Hands. Additional After Parties grant neither extension nor buffs.

catalog.name: The Kickback
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move all characters on both sides into this district. Each friendly character successfully moved gains +2 Hands. Locked cards and blocked destinations stay.

catalog.name: The Cookout
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Serve three Soul Food cards in occupied friendly districts; each cleanses your weakest character there and grants +2 Hands. Leave one Burnt Plate: at this round end it gives a random friendly character there 1 Burn, then clears.

catalog.name: The Baby Shower
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give every friendly character here +3 Hands, then draw up to two cards from your remaining deck.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Security
catalog.effect: On Reveal: The strongest enemy here loses 2 Hands. Ongoing: the first enemy played or moved into this district each round loses 1 Hand, and Security gains 1 Hand. Protection, immunity, and movement locks can stop the hostile effect.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Teknician
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Repeat the latest other friendly Squabblehouse staff On Reveal once (including Bus Boy, Cashier, and Waffle Warlord). The first other staff played into this district each round also repeats its On Reveal once. No eligible staff means no repeat; ongoing Janitor, dogs, and Teknicians are excluded.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Griddle Master
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Hit strongest enemy: strip Protection; deal 3 (5 if burning) damage + 1 Burn. Immunity/defenses apply.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Inmate Reformed
catalog.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly Squabblehouse staff member is here, gain 2 Hands. The strongest enemy here loses 1 Hand either way. Protection and immunity can block the hostile effect.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Bus Boy
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Move your lowest-Hands other friendly Squabblehouse staff member here to your weakest other district; if it arrives, it gains +1 Hand. Ongoing: At round start, attempt one counterable move to an adjacent lane, reversing direction at the edges. After a successful arrival, cleanse Weakened from all other friendly characters there and give the weakest other friendly character there +1 Hand. Frozen, locked, detained, movement-locked, or full destinations can stop a move.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Cashier
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Through next round: lock strongest enemy character (no moves/returns); Open Tab stops one legal enemy exit/return/round. Arrivals ignored. Defenses apply; echoes extend expiry, never recharge.

catalog.name: SquabbleHouse Waffle Warlord
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Give the weakest other friendly Squabblehouse staff member in each staffed district +1 Hand, or +2 Hands if you have staff in all three districts. Waffle Warlord is excluded from its own bonus.

catalog.name: Cane Corso (Red)
catalog.effect: When played, walk one adjacent lane toward your Red Triple OG. On Reveal and at each round start: while in your Red Triple OG’s district, the strongest enemy here that can lose Hands loses 1 Hand once this round. Walk one adjacent lane toward Red OG at round start. If Red OG is attacked, jump to it from anywhere and tank one counterable attack per round. Disabled or movement-locked dogs cannot jump.

catalog.name: Blue-Nose Pit
catalog.effect: When played, walk one adjacent lane toward your Blue Triple OG. On Reveal and at each round start: while in your Blue Triple OG’s district, give it +1 Hand and your weakest Blue Set ally in another district +2 Hands, once this round. Walk one adjacent lane toward Blue OG at round start. If Blue OG is attacked, jump to it from anywhere and tank one counterable attack per round. Disabled or movement-locked dogs cannot jump; Blue OG keeps its immunity to Hands loss.

catalog.name: Boo Boo the Fool
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Leave a Decoy here through next round. The next enemy character played or moved here takes 1 damage. If damage lands and Boo Boo is active, he moves to your weakest other open district and gains +1 Hand only if he arrives. One Decoy per side; each Boo Boo sets it once per match.

catalog.name: Mr. Mc Hands
catalog.effect: On Reveal: Hit up to two different strongest enemy characters here for 2 damage each. Each strike separately respects defenses.

catalog.name: Ms. Mary Mack
catalog.effect: Ongoing: At round end, collect 3¢ per enemy card on the board, up to 15¢.
